description: Configurations including security configurations are not established, documented, and managed.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not maintain documented baseline configurations for systems, applications, and network devices, or lack processes to manage, track, and enforce configuration standards including security hardening.

metadata.detection_notes: Review configuration management databases (CMDB), baseline configurations, security hardening guides, configuration drift detection, change tracking, and automated configuration enforcement tools (Infrastructure as Code, configuration management tools).
